environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with awsvpc networking mode. The container exposes port 8080 directly via an Application Load Balancer with no WAF attached. The task role has broad permissions (s3:*, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue). The ALB target group health check hits /api/v1/health. No network policy restricts outbound DNS or connections from the container. The ECS task metadata endpoint v4 is accessible at 169.254.170.2. CloudFront distribution exists but the ALB origin is also directly accessible via the ALB's public DNS name.

config.cloudfront_origin_access: no restriction on direct ALB access
